pages.title: Sherry & Friends
pages.narrative2: With a flutter of fairy wings and a sprinkle of stardust, the journey begins!

pages.title: Meet Ed!
pages.narrative: Once upon a sunny afternoon, Ed was full of cheerful ideas and ready to explore.
pages.narrative2: Surprise! Ed became a brave safari ranger, making friends with a giant friendly python!

pages.title: Meet Leslie!
pages.narrative: Leslie joined in with curious gadgets and big smiles, ready for the adventure ahead.
pages.narrative2: Ta-da! Leslie unveiled a mountain of magical treats and sparkling gadgets for everyone to share!

pages.title: Meet Anna & Pretzel!
pages.narrative: Anna bounded into the glade with Pretzel by her side, ready for warm hugs and cheerful adventures.
pages.narrative2: Ooh la la! Anna and Pretzel showed off their dazzling red carpet outfits, stealing the spotlight in vintage glam!

pages.title: Meet Jeremy!
pages.narrative: Jeremy arrived with grand blueprints, ready to align every master plan with strategic precision.
pages.narrative2: Mamma mia! Jeremy whipped up a legendary chicken rice feast with sizzling wok-hei and secret spices!

pages.title: Meet Kirill!
pages.narrative: Kirill strolled in cool and confident, ready to cheer everyone up with good vibes and laughter.
pages.narrative2: Prost! Kirill donned festive lederhosen and raised a frosty mug to celebrate great friendships and good times!

pages.title: Meet Mich!
pages.narrative: Mich brought boundless style and vibrant heart, turning every ordinary moment into something extraordinary.
pages.narrative2: Big heart energy! Mich showered the entire crew with heartwarming gifts and vibrant community cheer!

pages.title: Meet Sabrina!
pages.narrative: Sabrina lit up the world with radiant kindness, carrying giant heart balloons that floated on pure happiness.
pages.narrative2: Double the love! Sabrina shared heartwarming smiles and cheerful greetings that lifted everyone sky-high!

pages.title: Meet Steph!
pages.narrative: Steph was deep in thought at her desk, crafting big dreams with quiet determination and care.
pages.narrative2: Summit conquered! Steph planted the Project Symphony flag atop the highest peak, championing goodness for all!

pages.title: Meet Tag!
pages.narrative: Tag stood strong and steady in his team jacket, ready to support the squad through any adventure.
pages.narrative2: Confetti explosion! Tag unlocked a wonderland of Trust celebrations, adorable animal pals, and victory cheers!

pages.title: The End ✨
pages.narrative: Thank you for joining our magical tale! Happy memories and laughter forever.
